newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC says first-half domestic PC shipments up 30%.
newsitem.headline: NEC says first-half domestic PC shipments up 30%.

text.p: NEC Corp's senior vice president Yoshi Takayama told Reuters on Wednesday that the company's domestic personal computer (PC) shipments in the April to September period rose more than 30 percent from the same period a year ago.
An NEC spokesman said the company shipped 1.3 million PCs domestically in the year-ago period.
Takayama also said that the firm would achieve its target of 3.8 million domestic PC shipments in this fiscal year to the end of March 1997, up 28 percent from last year.

The growth in shipments in the first half of this year was more or less in line with the expansion of Japan's total PC market, meaning NEC's market share would not decrease from its current 50 percent, Takayama said.
Private research companies IDC Corp and Dataquest have both estimated NEC's share of the Japanese market last year at about 40 percent.
